description.en: Bring health, places, and spending into one personal picture.
description.zh: 把健康指标、位置足迹和消费记录，汇成一幅个人生活图景。

source.description: Unified personal data hub for health metrics, location, and expense tracking

subject.en: Caramel capybara with closed eyes, blue-purple glasses, and an apple with leaves
subject.zh: 闭眼的焦糖色水豚，保留蓝紫镜框、苹果和叶片

description.en: The broad muzzle and relaxed closed eyes stay dominant. A natural short neck and shoulder enter from the lower left, leaving the whole apple, ear, and outer glasses arm inside the safe frame.
description.zh: 宽鼻口与放松闭眼仍是主体，短颈和肩部从左下自然进入画面，完整苹果、耳朵和外侧镜框都留在安全范围内。

description.en: Warm connected polygons retain the capybara’s coat and expression. The original apple and blue-purple glasses keep their color relationship, with clean transparent gaps around the frame.
description.zh: 暖色连续多边形保留水豚毛色与表情，原有苹果和蓝紫眼镜保持配色关系，镜框空隙干净透明。

description.en: Broken elliptical water rings and one quiet leaf-vein impression fill a warm sand field. The broad tonal texture gives the portrait a calm setting without becoming a scene.
description.zh: 断续椭圆水纹与一处安静叶脉落在暖沙色底面上，以宽阔同色纹理衬托平静头像。

palette.source: Selected Life.ai presentation, 2026-09-07-01/02; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: The broad caramel muzzle, red apple, and blue-purple glasses remain visible at 32 px. Closed eyes and small leaf facets simplify at 16 px; the 192 px login asset is also transparent.
sizeNote.zh: 32 像素时，焦糖宽鼻口、红苹果和蓝紫眼镜仍可辨认；16 像素时闭眼与细叶切面会简化，登录页的 192 像素资源也使用透明前景。

goal.en: Import personal health, location, and bookkeeping exports, then compare them through daily, monthly, and yearly views.
goal.zh: 导入个人健康、位置足迹和记账导出文件，通过日、月、年视图对照查看。

role.zh: 数据处理与 SQLite 运行环境

role.en: Local health, route, and finance databases
role.zh: 本地健康、轨迹与记账数据库

description.en: Broken horizontal water rings meet a single leaf vein, recalling the capybara’s unhurried riverbank.
description.zh: 断开的横向水环与一脉叶纹相遇，留住水豚河岸旁不慌不忙的气息。

alt.en: Caramel capybara with closed eyes, blue-purple glasses, and an apple with leaves on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 闭眼的焦糖色水豚，保留蓝紫镜框、苹果和叶片，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.zh: 把生活的不同面向，一起看见。

description.en: Caramel capybara with closed eyes, blue-purple glasses, and an apple with leaves.
description.zh: 闭眼的焦糖色水豚，保留蓝紫镜框、苹果和叶片。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Keep the existing portrait's natural frame entry. The full square is placed against the baseline; no anatomy is extended, trimmed or masked. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留原头像自然入框的边界，将完整方形画布贴齐基线；不补画、不截取解剖结构。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥71px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 71px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
